name: Akaviri
description: Akaviri folded steel, left by the invaders of 2E 572. No smith in the marsh can make it.
why_here: The Akaviri invaders of 2E 572 were driven into the sea across Thorn and Stormhold. Their steel remains.

name: Bone
description: Beast-bone, ground to an edge and lashed with sinew. It holds that edge for one fight.
why_here: The Naga-Kur and Xit-Xaht make weapons and plate from bone. Grave-singers harvest it.

name: Bronze
description: Copper alloy, hammered and edged by a village smith. It is made in the marsh.
why_here: Saxhleel smiths worked bronze before the Duskfall and still edge their blades with copper alloy.

name: Daedric
description: Ebony quenched in a heart still beating. It does not rust.
why_here: Dagon's war parties and the ruin of Ten-Maur-Wolk leave daedric arms in the marsh.

name: Dwarven
description: Dwemer alloy, still bright after four thousand years.
why_here: Dwemer metal came south in Dunmer colonial trade and as spoil from the war of 4E 6.

name: Ebony
description: The blood of a god, cooled and hammered flat.
why_here: Ebony came south as Dunmer trade and as spoil from the sack of Mournhold in 4E 6.

name: Elven
why_here: Aldmeri invaders and Maormer sea raiders left elven kit along the coast and rivers.

name: Chitin
description: Chitin lashed to bone, sting-edged. It smells of the swamp.
why_here: Chitin, horn and bone are working materials here; giant wasps and mudcrabs supply the shell.

name: Hackwing
description: Hackwing hide, feather and bone, bound with cord. Light enough for running.
why_here: Hackwing hide and plumage is what the marsh's hunters prize above any other.

name: Glass
description: Malachite, ground to a hard, brittle edge.
why_here: Malachite plate is a Dunmer-war and Imperial luxury. Argonians work glass themselves.

name: Imperial
description: Legion pattern, forged for a shield wall, now stacked in a levy store.
why_here: The Legion garrisoned the marsh for millennia and its levies inherited the pattern.

name: Iron
description: Bog iron, heavy and soft. What a levy or a work gang is handed.
why_here: Bog iron is the marsh's working metal, smelted in small works for levies and gangs.

name: Volcanic Glass
description: Volcanic glass knapped to a green-black edge, from the xanmeers. It cuts deeper than steel, but it chips.
why_here: Pre-Duskfall Argonians knapped volcanic glass for the weapons found in xanmeers.

name: Orcish
description: Orichalcum, beaten thick. Built to break things.
why_here: Orsimer mercenaries took Imperial pay in the province. Their arms remain.

name: Silver
description: Soft metal. It harms the undead.
why_here: Argonians work silver into frill clips and flutes. The Collections traded it.

name: Steel
description: Trade steel with a copper-bright edge. It is imported.
why_here: Imperial, Dunmer and pirate traders bring in steel; local smiths give it a copper edge.

name: Studded
description: Crocodile hide riveted with bog iron. Light.
why_here: Crocodile and hackwing hide riveted with bog iron is what the marsh's hunters wear.

name: Wood
description: Tamarack or hardwood, fire-cured and bound with rawhide. Any village can make one in a morning.
why_here: Hist-bark bows and fire-cured hardwood are the marsh's oldest working kit; any village makes them.
